spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_dash.name: Blood Dash
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_dash.descript: Thrown the way you look, once more in the air before you land; looking up, a great leap. No fall damage till you've landed. Costs 50 mB. Out of mist it goes harder.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_pound.name: Groundpound
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_pound.descrip: In the air: down like a stone. Everyone near where you land is thrown back and hurt, and every person near shows through walls for a while. Costs 150 mB. A Rend straight after reaches the ones it threw.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_gaze.name: Blood Gaze
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_gaze.descript: A red laser out of both eyes for a second, exactly where you look: a Frost-born's beam in blood, hurting what it touches and sometimes taking or breaking the part it lands on. Costs 200 mB.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.122: A vampire's Blood Dash, Groundpound, Blood Gaze (a second's red laser from the eyes) and Feed sit on the skill bar beside the hotbar, with the shapes, the stare and the claws.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_feed.name: Feed
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_feed.descript: Empty-handed, at the prey in front of you (the one in your sights first): take them by the throat and drink fast as you walk; Feed again throws them, through anything softer than stone if you're well fed. A sleeper gets a quiet first bite. Downed ones too. Every drink fills your blood.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feed.none: No one close enough to feed on.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_bat.name: Bat
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_bat.descripti: Become a small thing with wings, and fly. Costs 300 mB, a quarter less at night, and the flight drinks 100 mB every three seconds. Use it again to turn back.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_colony.name: Colony
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_colony.descri: A swarm of bats lifts the one in front of you off the ground and drops it. Costs 600 mB, a quarter less at night. Players only where players may fight.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_mist.name: Mist
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_mist.descript: Nothing can hurt you and you can hurt nothing; you drift. Costs 400 mB, a quarter less at night. Blood Dash or a right-click leap out of it goes harder and costs half. Use it again to turn back.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_stare.name: Stare
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_stare.descrip: Fix your eyes. Whoever is weaker than you and held in your gaze comes to you and stands by you. Costs 200 mB, and 100 mB for every second the hold lasts.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_rake.name: Rake
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_rake.descript: Three quick slashes at the foe in front of you, each one a wound; twice as hard on a pinned foe. Costs 100 mB. After a Blood Dash it reaches further and costs half.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_rend.name: Rend
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_rend.descript: One tearing blow. A foe near death (never a great one) is killed outright and its blood mends you. Costs 150 mB. Straight after a Groundpound it flies at one the pound threw, for half.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_pounce.name: Pounce
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_pounce.descri: Fly at the foe in front of you and bear it down: it is pinned under you for a moment. Costs 150 mB. After a Blood Dash it finds a foe further off and costs half.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_roar.name: Roar
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_roar.descript: Everything near that can fear does; for a while you are stronger and quicker, your claws open two wounds a blow and you heal twice as fast. Costs 300 mB.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.209: Every move a vampire has sits on the skill bar beside the hotbar: the shapes, the stare, the claws and the roar. Each one costs blood, and a move run straight into the next costs half.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.210: A vampire's hunger is a row of dark vials where the food bar was, two thousand millibuckets in all. Bites, bottles of blood and spilt blood fill it; moves, shapes and the sun drain it. Below 200 it is starving.
